claim_boundaries: Runtime stability metadata is operational metadata, not model-quality evidence.
Interrupted or partial live-local runs are excluded from local/open-weight rankings.
A deferred heavy local target can be retried only after explicit operator opt-in and updated stability metadata.
Smoke/control targets remain excluded from publication claims.
Cloud-labelled targets remain excluded from local/open-weight claims.

purpose: Public-safe runtime stability metadata for live-local model runs, with explicit stop criteria for heavier targets.

stop_criteria.required_action: Stop the run, keep raw/local artifacts ignored, and record only public-safe blocker metadata.
stop_criteria.trigger: Operator observes memory pressure, swap activity, or sustained paging during a live-local run.

stop_criteria.required_action: Stop or defer the run until the operator can document a stable machine profile.
stop_criteria.trigger: Thermal throttling, unstable power state, or other machine instability is observed.

stop_criteria.required_action: Exclude the incomplete run from rankings and require a fresh complete reviewed run before ledgering.
stop_criteria.trigger: The model is unavailable, repeatedly times out, or cannot complete the selected split.
